import awkward as ak
from pocket_coffea.lib.processor import Processor


class DimuonAnalyzer(Processor):
    def object_preselection(self, variation):
        """Build MuonGood collection: pT > 15 GeV, |eta| < 2.4"""
        muons = self.events.Muon
        self.events["MuonGood"] = muons[
            (muons.pt > 15) & (abs(muons.eta) < 2.4)
        ]

    def object_counting(self, variation):
        """Store number of selected muons per event"""
        self.events["nMuonGood"] = ak.num(self.events.MuonGood)
